## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant denial, success, recovery and isolation tests pass.
- [ ] `npm run verify` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] Contract/generated docs and change log reflect the change.
- [ ] Security, dependencies, licenses and recurring costs reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets, live funds or unverified production claims included.
- [ ] Public text and outgoing commit messages reviewed for audience and purpose using [the public writing guide](https://github.com/Moovha/wallet-provider-kit/blob/main/docs/public-writing.md); the PR title/body are self-contained.
- [ ] Commits have DCO `Signed-off-by` trailers.
